summary: RocketFuel Blockchain filed an 8-K reporting entry into and closing of an Asset Purchase Agreement dated July 22, 2026, selling substantially all of its payments business to RPay Inc., a Delaware corporation whose sole director and CEO, Peter M. Jensen, is also a director and executive officer of RocketFuel. Consideration consists of RPay's assumption of $800,000 deferred compensation owed to Jensen and $200,000 to Bennett J. Yankowitz, plus a warrant for 160,000 RPay shares at $0.001 par, subject to a $1,000,000 reported threshold. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium was disclosed. A concurrent sale of the loyalty and rewards business to RPoints Inc. will be reported separately. Watch for related-party conflict scrutiny and the eventual value of the RPay warrant.
